messages.content: Implement a Python function from a JSON behavioral card. The card is the only task specification. Return a JSON object with a single string field code containing executable Python source. Define solve with the card's exact signature. Use only Python's standard library. Allowed imports: math, itertools, functools, collections, heapq, bisect, statistics, fractions, operator, typing. Do not import or call NumPy, SymPy, NetworkX or any other third-party library. Do not read files, use network, introspection, eval, exec, input or print. Implement computations yourself using built-ins and the allowed standard library. Return plain JSON-compatible values, not iterators or sets; use string keys in dictionaries. Include any helper functions in the code. No tests or main block. Raise ValueError where the card requires it.

Implement this card:
{
  "algorithm": [
    "For each integer i from 1 to sqrt(n), check if i divides n evenly",
    "If i divides n evenly, add i and n//i to the list of divisors",
    "Sort the list of divisors in ascending order",
    "If generator=True, return the list as an unordered generator instead of a sorted list"
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "n must be a positive integer <= 5000",
    "divisors returns a sorted list by default (ascending order from 1 to n)",
    "generator=True returns an unordered generator of divisors",
    "divisor_count uses default modulus=1 and proper=False (not implemented here)",
    "The function does not handle negative numbers or non-integer inputs"
  ],
  "edge_cases": [
    "n=1: divisors are [1]",
    "n=prime: divisors are [1, n]",
    "n=0: not allowed (n is positive integer)",
    "n=5000: maximum input size"
  ],
  "inputs": "n: positive integer <= 5000",
  "method_id": "sympy.divisors",
  "output": "If generator=False (default): sorted list of all positive divisors of n from 1 to n. If generator=True: unordered generator of all positive divisors of n",
  "purpose": "Return all positive divisors of n sorted in ascending order by default, or an unordered generator if generator=True",
  "signature": "solve(n)"
}
